outfit_policy.rule: Wardrobe MUST change between separate episodes/videos. The listed wardrobe is a character style anchor, not a permanently locked outfit.
outfit_policy.within_episode: For one episode, select one outfit per character and keep it exactly consistent across every shot, camera angle, pose, and generated frame in that episode.
outfit_policy.between_episodes: Choose a visibly different outfit for each new episode, suitable for the story, location, weather, season, time of day, and occasion.
outfit_policy.identity_lock: Changing clothes must never change the character's face, age, skin tone, body proportions, hairstyle, or distinctive identifying features.
outfit_policy.turnaround: Generate all five angle views using the outfit selected for that specific episode; never mix outfits between angles.
outfit_policy.variety: Rotate colors, garments, layers, and accessories naturally while preserving the character's recognizable personal style.
